questions.q: Which school of magic does Harry Potter attend?
questions.fact: Hogwarts is in Scotland, in the books.

questions.q: In Toy Story, what is the cowboy doll called?
questions.fact: Tom Hanks voices Woody in the films.

questions.q: How many rings are on the Olympic flag?
questions.fact: They stand for the five regions of the world joined together.

questions.q: Which band sang 'Bohemian Rhapsody'?
questions.fact: Freddie Mercury was Queen's lead singer.

questions.q: Which country won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
questions.fact: Argentina beat France on penalties in the final in Qatar.

questions.q: What is the name of Mickey Mouse's pet dog?
questions.fact: Pluto is the only one of the main characters who doesn't talk.

questions.q: Which sport is played at Wimbledon?
questions.fact: Wimbledon is played on grass, and players traditionally wear white.

questions.q: Which actor plays Iron Man in the Marvel films?
questions.fact: Iron Man's first film came out in 2008.

questions.q: In which sport would you score a slam dunk?
questions.fact: The hoop is 10 feet (3.05 metres) off the ground.

questions.q: What is the lion cub called in The Lion King?
questions.fact: Simba means 'lion' in Swahili.

questions.q: Which animated film features the song 'Let It Go'?
questions.fact: It won the Oscar for best original song in 2014.

questions.q: How many players does one basketball team have on court?
questions.fact: Each team can have up to 12 players in the squad.

questions.q: Which Pokémon is the famous yellow mascot?
questions.fact: Pikachu's name comes from two Japanese sound words, for sparks and for a mouse's squeak.

questions.q: In UK Monopoly, which is the most expensive property?
questions.fact: Mayfair costs £400 and Park Lane £350.

questions.q: What is the name of Mario's younger brother?
questions.fact: Luigi first appeared in the arcade game Mario Bros. in 1983.

questions.q: Which Beatle played the drums?
questions.fact: Ringo joined the band in 1962.

questions.q: In which sport do you score a birdie?
questions.fact: A birdie is one stroke under par for a hole.

questions.q: What is the maximum break in snooker?
questions.fact: It takes 15 reds with 15 blacks, then all six colours.

questions.q: What is the name of Harry Potter's pet owl?
questions.fact: Hedwig was a gift from Hagrid for Harry's 11th birthday.

questions.q: What is the highest score possible with three darts?
questions.fact: That means three treble 20s.

questions.q: Which city hosted the Olympic Games in 2012?
questions.fact: It was the third time London had hosted the Games.

questions.q: What is Homer Simpson's wife called?
questions.fact: Marge is famous for her tall blue hair.

questions.q: What type of fish is Nemo?
questions.fact: Clownfish live safely among the stinging arms of sea anemones.

questions.q: About how long is a marathon?
questions.fact: It is exactly 26 miles and 385 yards (42.195 km).

questions.q: Which singer is known as the Queen of Pop?
questions.fact: Madonna's first big hit was 'Holiday' in 1983.

questions.q: What is the name of the fictional African country in Black Panther?
questions.fact: Wakanda is home to the metal vibranium.

questions.q: Which racing sport is Lewis Hamilton famous for?
questions.fact: He has won the Formula 1 world title seven times.

questions.q: Which instrument has black and white keys?
questions.fact: A standard piano has 88 keys.

questions.q: What colour is Kermit the Frog?
questions.fact: Kermit first appeared in 1955.
